verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird runs a public TwoVenture hub that gives start-ups guidance across the venture capital life cycle (Start & Seed, Scale & Growth, Exit & Beyond). It also publishes downloadable equity-incentive factsheets (EMI, Growth Shares, CSOP, SIP) and a free German Term Sheet Generator, which together touch financing and equity. The hub's actual content depth and format are unevidenced, so this is partial. missing for 10: evidence of the hub's actual plain-language guides or FAQs, coverage of company formation topics, independent corroboration of the knowledge base's breadth and accessibility.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages

citations.quote: Welcome to TwoVenture — A hub to provide guidance to start-up and scale-up companies and their investors through the venture capital life cycle
The Term Sheet Generator Tool is free to use
